initial_state.proposal_topic_title: Multi-Agent RL Coordination in Simulated and Real Robotic Teams
initial_state.research_context_summary:
Coordinating teams of physical robots requires policies that transfer from simulation to hardware without catastrophic performance loss. The four participating labs approach this challenge from complementary angles: sim-to-real transfer via LoopSR and HIB (Alpha and Delta), competitive multi-agent RL via Off-FSP (Beta), and world-model-based perception for legged locomotion (Gamma).

A key open question is whether cooperative multi-agent RL can borrow the offline self-play machinery developed for competitive settings. Off-FSP's Nash-equilibrium approximation might guide cooperative policy search by treating team sub-goals as competing objectives.
